77432-desolate-splendour.title: Splendour
77432-desolate-splendour.creator: Unknown
77432-desolate-splendour.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. from the Severn flats bordered the park wall, so that by that way and through the tall gates lay the principal approach to Morvane. The crumbling stones of the boundary wall edged a grass-grown lane, rutted by an occasional cart, but for the rest abandoned to a tangle of wild flowers and to the murmur of indifferent bees.

arxiv-2107-04745.title: Self-calibrating interloper bias in spectroscopic galaxy clustering surveys
arxiv-2107-04745.creator: Yan Gong ∗1 , Haitao Miao 1 , Pengjie Zhang ∗2,3,4 , Xuelei Chen 1,5,6
arxiv-2107-04745.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yan Gong ∗1 , Haitao Miao 1 , Pengjie Zhang ∗2,3,4 , Xuelei Chen 1,5,6. Contamination of interloper galaxies due to misidentified emission lines can be a big issue in the spectroscopic galaxy clustering surveys, especially in the future high-precision observations.

arxiv-2108-06708.title: Manifolds for which Huber’s Theorem holds Thanks: The first author is partially supported by NSFC, Grant No.12141103
arxiv-2108-06708.creator: Yuxiang Li, Zihao Wang
arxiv-2108-06708.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yuxiang Li, Zihao Wang. Extensions of Huber’s Theorem to higher dimensions with L n 2 L^{\frac{n}{2}} bounded scalar curvature have been extensively studied over the years. In this paper, we delve into the properties of conformal metrics on a punctured ball with ‖ R ‖ L n 2 < + ∞ \|R\|_{L^{\frac{n}{2}}}<+\infty , aiming to identify necessary geometric constraints for Huber’s theorem to be applicable. Unexpectedly, such metrics are more rigid than we initially anticipated.

arxiv-2204-09074.title: Substructures in protoplanetary disks imprinted by compact planetary systems Fargo3D ( Benítez-Llambay & Masset 2016 ) , Numpy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) .
arxiv-2204-09074.creator: Juan Garrido-Deutelmoser, Cristobal Petrovich, Leonardo Krapp, Kaitlin M. Kratter, Ruobing Dong
arxiv-2204-09074.description: Abstract The substructures observed in protoplanetary disks may be the signposts of embedded planets carving gaps or creating vortices. The inferred masses of these planets often fall in the Jovian regime despite their low abundance compared to lower-mass planets, partly because previous works often assume that a single substructure (a gap or vortex) is caused by a single planet.

arxiv-2205-09291.title: Empirical Measure Large Deviations for Reinforced Chains on Finite Spaces
arxiv-2205-09291.creator: Amarjit Budhiraja, Adam Waterbury
arxiv-2205-09291.description: Abstract Let A A be a transition probability kernel on a finite state space Δ o = { 1 , … , d } \Delta^{o}=\{1,\ldots,d\} such that A ⁡ ( x , y ) > 0 A(x,y)>0 for all x , y ∈ Δ o x,y\in\Delta^{o} .

arxiv-2211-11055.title: Data-based determination of the isospin-limit light-quark-connected
arxiv-2211-11055.creator: contribution to the anomalous magnetic moment of the muon
arxiv-2211-11055.description: Abstract We describe how recent determinations of exclusive-mode contributions to a_{\mu}^{\rm LO,HVP} , the leading-order hadronic vacuum polarization contribution to the anomalous magnetic moment of the muon, can be used to provide, up to small electromagnetic (EM) corrections accessible from the lattice, a data-based dispersive determination of a_{\mu}^{\rm lqc;\,IL} , the isospin-limit, light-quark-connected contribution to a_{\mu}^{\rm LO,HVP} .

arxiv-2305-16801.title: Motion-Based Sign Language Video Summarization using Curvature and Torsion
arxiv-2305-16801.creator: Evangelos G. Sartinas, Emmanouil Z. Psarakis, Dimitrios I. Kosmopoulos
arxiv-2305-16801.description: Abstract An interesting problem in many video-based applications is the generation of short synopses by selecting the most informative frames, a procedure which is known as video summarization. For sign language videos the benefits of using the t t -parameterized counterpart of the curvature of the 2-D signer’s wrist trajectory to identify keyframes, have been recently reported in the literature.

arxiv-2306-16594.title: Three-dimensional viscous steady streaming in a rectangular channel past a cylinder
arxiv-2306-16594.creator: Nathan Willis, Christel Hohenegger
arxiv-2306-16594.description: Abstract . We consider viscous steady streaming induced by oscillatory flow past a cylinder between two plates, where the cylinder’s axis is normal to the plates. While this phenomenon was first studied in the 1930s, it has received renewed interest recently for possible applications in particle manipulations and non-Newtonian flows.

arxiv-2401-10707.title: Non-Fermi-Liquid/Marginal-Fermi-Liquid Signatures Induced by Van Hove Singularity
arxiv-2401-10707.creator: Yi-Hui Xing 1,2, Wu-Ming Liu 1,2,3
arxiv-2401-10707.description: Abstract We theoretically study the two-dimensional metal that is coupled to critical magnons and features van Hove singularities on the Fermi surface. When there is only translationally invariant SYK-liked Yukawa interaction, van Hove points suppress the contribution from the part of the Fermi surface away from them, dominating and exhibiting non-Fermi-liquid behavior.

arxiv-2403-05655.title: PROTEST : Nonparametric Testing of Hypotheses Enhanced by Experts’ Utility Judgements
arxiv-2403-05655.creator: Rodrigo F. L. Lassance, Rafael Izbicki, Rafael B. Stern
arxiv-2403-05655.description: Abstract Instead of testing solely a precise hypothesis, it is often useful to enlarge it with alternatives that are deemed to differ from it negligibly. For instance, in a bioequivalence study one might consider the hypothesis that the concentration of an ingredient is exactly the same in two drugs.

arxiv-2412-18574.title: Inferring intermediate states by leveraging the many-body Arrhenius law
arxiv-2412-18574.creator: Vishwajeet Kumar, Arnab Pal, Ohad Shpielberg
arxiv-2412-18574.description: Abstract Metastable states appear as long-lived intermediate states in various natural transport phenomena which are governed by energy landscapes. Moreover, they dominate a system’s evolution in deciding the selective outcome or shedding light on the preferred mechanism on how a system explores the energy landscape.

arxiv-2505-09612.title: Adaptively-weighted Nearest Neighbors for Matrix Completion
arxiv-2505-09612.creator: Tathagata Sadhukhan, Manit Paul, Raaz Dwivedi
arxiv-2505-09612.description: Abstract In this technical note, we introduce and analyze 𝖠𝖶𝖭𝖭 \mathsf{AWNN} – an adaptively weighted nearest neighbor method for performing matrix completion. Nearest neighbor (NN) methods are widely used in missing data problems across multiple disciplines such as in recommender systems and for performing counterfactual inference in panel data settings.

arxiv-2508-17553.title: Quantum-Assisted Learning of Time-Dependent Parabolic PDEs Thanks: The authors acknowledge the support of the Danish e-Infrastructure Consortium (DeiC) and the National Quantum Algorithm Academy (NQAA) through the Postdoctoral Scholarship under the project “Quantum-Driven Solutions for Multi-Agent S
arxiv-2508-17553.creator: Nahid Binandeh Dehaghani, Ban Tran, A. Pedro Aguiar, Rafal Wisniewski, Susan Mengel
arxiv-2508-17553.description: Abstract We present a hybrid quantum-classical framework for solving general time-dependent parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs) using quantum variational circuits. Building on the QPINN approach, this method applies broadly to parabolic PDEs. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we focus on the 1D and 2D heat equations as representative examples and analyze its performance under constrained quantum resources.

openalex-w7218878386.description: Introduction: Characterizing the clinical profile of patients undergoing cardiac catheterization is essential for planning and performing the procedure in hemodynamics units, aiming to minimize complications and determine the best course of action. Method: This is a descriptive...

pmc-11450619.title: Enhancing quality of life in epilepsy with a digital intervention (emyna): Results of the ELAINE randomized controlled trial
pmc-11450619.creator: Björn Meyer, Linda T Betz, Katja Brückner, Martin Holtkamp
pmc-11450619.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveDespite the availability of pharmacological treatment for seizures, people with epilepsy (PwE) commonly experience impairments in quality of life (QoL). Given the limited access to psychosocial treatments for PwE, digital interventions could bridge treatment gaps and help improve QoL. The objective of this study was to examine the effectiveness of emyna, a fully automated digital intervention based on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) techniques, in improving health‐related QoL among PwE who reported impairments in QoL.

pmc-11653195.title: Digital twins for chronic lung diseases
pmc-11653195.creator: Apolline Gonsard, Martin Genet, David Drummond
pmc-11653195.description: Digital twins have recently emerged in healthcare. They combine advances in cyber–physical systems, modelling and computation techniques, and enable a bidirectional flow of information between the physical and virtual entities. In respiratory medicine, progress in connected devices and artificial intelligence make it technically possible to obtain digital twins that allow real-time visualisation of a patient's respiratory health.

pmc-11690990.title: RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN BLOOD BIOENERGETICS AND LEG COMPOSITION ACROSS THE HUMAN LIFE COURSE
pmc-11690990.creator: Adrian Arciniega, Howard Phang, Jaclyn Bergstrom, Anthony Molina
pmc-11690990.description: The human aging process is marked by changes in body composition, such as muscle loss and bone loss, which may be related to mitochondrial dysfunction. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) are being used to report on systematic mitochondrial function and have been associated with the bioenergetic capacity of various tissues.

pmc-11716047.title: Predicting individual‐level stroke risk associated with risperidone use in dementia using cardiovascular disease history: matched UK population based cohort study
pmc-11716047.creator: Nalamotse Joshua Choma, Alys Griffiths, William E Henley, Christoph Mueller, Nefyn Williams, John Dennis, Byron Creese
pmc-11716047.description: BackgroundExperiencing behavioural symptoms such as aggression, agitation and psychosis contribute significantly to reduced quality of life amongst people with dementia. These behavioral symptoms can be considered more detrimental to overall well‐being than cognitive impairment. In the UK, risperidone is the sole approved atypical antipsychotic for treating these symptoms, despite its notable risk of serious side effects, including stroke.

pmc-12387028.title: Food Protein-Induced Enterocolitis Syndrome Across Lifespan: Focus on Adolescence
pmc-12387028.creator: Marta Barbato, Mariannita Gelsomino, Giulia Bersani, Francesco Mastellone, Valentina Giorgio, Ludovica Iezzi, Rosa Buonagura, Cristiano Caruso, Stefano Miceli Sopo, Angela Rizzi, Takao Fujisawa
pmc-12387028.description: Background/Objectives: Food protein-induced enterocolitis syndrome (FPIES) is a food-related hypersensitivity disorder characterized by delayed repeated vomiting that typically presents within the first years of life. Although FPIES has traditionally been considered a pediatric condition, it has more recently been observed also in teenagers and adults.

pmc-12595292.title: Hepatitis E virus screening in solid organ transplant recipients: prevalence and implications for implementation, Spain, 2021 to 2023
pmc-12595292.creator: Sara Pereira, Alfredo Pérez-Rivilla, Raquel Carracedo, Pedro López-López, Manuel Rodríguez-Iglesias, Rafael Benito, Ana Fuentes, Miguel Ángel López-Ruz, Carolina Freyre-Carrillo, María Del Valle Odero, Noelia Parajó, Federico García, Antonio Rivero, Antonio Rivero-Juárez, Antonio Aguilera
pmc-12595292.description: INTRODUCTION: In solid organ transplant (SOT) recipients, hepatitis E virus (HEV) poses a complex clinical challenge, because there is a risk of developing persistent infection. Current European guidelines recommend the screening of HEV in SOT recipients because of the risk of unrecognised infection. Despite these recommendations, routine screening for HEV remains underutilised in clinical practice.

pmc-12618751.title: Synergetic contributions of Seneca Valley virus 3 C and 3D proteins to induction of ferroptosis for viral replication
pmc-12618751.creator: Jiangwei Song, Jingjing Yang, Ruiyi Ma, Zijian Li, Jiayao Su, Shijie Xie, Peipei Cheng
pmc-12618751.description: Seneca Valley virus (SVV) infection leads to severe vesicular diseases in pigs, posing a significant threat to the global swine industry. Ferroptosis, a novel form of non-apoptotic cell death, is characterized by iron-dependent phospholipid peroxidation. However, the role of ferroptosis in SVV replication remains poorly understood.

pmc-12656689.title: Phytoremediation Potential of Heavy Metals Using Biochar and Accumulator Plants: A Sustainable Approach Towards Cleaner Environments
pmc-12656689.creator: Marcos Rosas-Ramírez, Efraín Tovar-Sánchez, Alexis Rodríguez, María Luisa Castrejón-Godínez, Hugo Albeiro Saldarriaga-Noreña, Luz Bretón-Deval, Patricia Mussali-Galante, Lin Guo, Teresa J Cutright
pmc-12656689.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Native plant species show significant promise for the remediation and rehabilitation of mine tailings contaminated with heavy metals (HM). Nonetheless, the harmful impact of HM can decrease plant survival, growth and reproduction, thereby diminishing the effectiveness of phytoremediation. Consequently, incorporating organic amendments into mine tailings, like biochar, can promote plant growth, decreasing the bioavailability of HM and their eventual potential to alter the food chain.

pmc-12844998.title: Bridging the Knowledge Gap in Harmaline’s Pharmacological Properties: A Focus on Thermodynamics and Kinetics
pmc-12844998.creator: Tatyana Volkova, Olga Simonova, German Perlovich
pmc-12844998.description: Background/Objectives: Advancing information on the key physicochemical properties of biologically active substances enables the development of formulations with reduced dosing, lower toxicity, and minimal adverse effects. This work addresses the knowledge gap concerning the pharmacologically relevant properties of harmaline (HML), with a focus on thermodynamic and kinetic aspects.

pmc-13273883.title: Metoclopramide-induced hyperprolactinemia during pregnancy and lactating alters chondrocyte proliferation and apoptosis in the murine femoral and tibial epiphyseal growth plate
pmc-13273883.creator: Osvaldo P. Araujo-Jr, Regina C.T. Gomes, Ariadne S.L. Araujo, Edmund C. Baracat, Ricardo S. Simões, Manuel de J. Simões, José M. Soares Junior

pmc-13448656.title: Experimental, numerical, and data-driven analysis of impulsive ice-shedding-induced vibrations in wind turbine blades
pmc-13448656.creator: Iyad F. Al-Najjar, Károly Jálics, László E. Kollár
pmc-13448656.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This research investigates the dynamic response of a glass-filled nylon wind turbine blade subjected to ice shedding and turbulent wind conditions, with the aim of understanding and predicting structural behaviour under realistic operating scenarios. Experiments were conducted to capture the blade’s vibration response under controlled conditions, with the blade fixed at the root and measurements taken at the mid-span and tip.

However, such conductors with cation-centered polyhedral frameworks are relatively rigid and afford insufficient lattice free volume for the migration of interstitial oxygen. pmc-13556605.title: 548. Glucagon-like peptide-1 agonists and their association with worsening mental illness in individuals with depression and anxiety. Results from a nationwide cohort study from Sweden
pmc-13556605.creator: H Taipale, M Taylor, M Lähteenvuo, E Mittendorfer-Rutz, A Tanskanen, J Tiihonen
pmc-13556605.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundIndividuals with diabetes have an elevated risk of developing depression, anxiety, and suicide. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) are licensed to treat diabetes and obesity but data on whether GLP-1RA alleviate or exacerbate anxiety, depression, and self-harm are mixed.Aims & ObjectivesWe studied the risk of worsening mental illness in people already diagnosed with depression and/or anxiety who were prescribed antidiabetic medications including GLP-1RA.MethodWe conducted a nationwide cohort study utilizing the national Swedish register.
